scope.summary: One original-ROM shop menu was observed. The observation proves only which rod rows appeared in that captured menu context; it does not establish a six-stage shop map.
scope.stock_table_note: No ROM stock table or routine offset has been identified. The item-record tables contain names and base prices, not demonstrated shop availability flags.

runtime_observation.navigation: The visible rod selector was advanced with Right. Eight unique choices appeared; further Right presses remained on the final visible choice.

purchase_attempt.message_japanese: お金が足らないけれど。
purchase_attempt.note: The menu displayed the item and price, but the captured save state lacked enough money to complete a purchase.

runtime_observation.capture_method: Original Japanese ROM run with the local Snes9x Libretro core from a copied local shop-menu save state. Save states and ROM data are not part of the publication.

limitations: A ROM base-price field does not prove an item is sold by a particular shop or available in a particular stage.
Only the rod category was traversed in this shop context. Lure IDs 17, 18, 2E, 2F, 30, 31, 23, and 24 were not observed in its menu.
The visible region text 渓流 has not been mapped to one of the six guide stages from ROM evidence.
No other shop, shop category, progression flag, time condition, or alternate stock set was tested.
